project.objective: Find what became of the Tyler midwife (b. Apr 1853, Virginia) of Cunningham District, Fluvanna County, Virginia, after the 1900 census, and where she was before it

questions.question: Where was the widowed midwife enumerated as '[given name blank] Tyler' in the 1900 census of Cunningham District, Fluvanna County, Virginia, before 1900 and after it?
questions.rationale: Her given name is in doubt (readings Ann, Antone, Anthony) and the 1900 entry carries none; her later and earlier enumerations should settle it.

items.rationale: The censuses after 1900 should show where she lived and with whom; a death after 1912 would have a Virginia certificate.
The 1870 census is the first to name formerly enslaved people; she would have been about 17.
